# plans

Migration plan directory storing executable task-by-task migration blueprints for llmux infrastructure changes. Agentic workers reference these plans to execute structured migrations with verification requirements.

## Contents

- [2026-04-30-bun-migration.md](./2026-04-30-bun-migration.md) defines Bun 1.2+ runtime migration from npm/Node.js, including engine constraints, script transformations, Dockerfile updates, and verification requirements

## Behavioral Contracts

Engine requirement: `"bun": ">=1.2.0"`. Package manager: `"packageManager": "bun@1.2.0"`. Docker base images: `oven/bun:1.2-alpine`. Health check: `CMD wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1`. Install flags: `--frozen-lockfile`, `--production`. Build target: `bun build --target=node src/index.ts --outdir=dist`. Workers deploy: `wrangler deploy` (Cloudflare requirement). Lockfile names: `bun.lock` (root), `workers/bun.lock` (subproject).

## File Changes Required

Modify `package.json` (engines, packageManager, scripts, remove tsx). Modify `workers/package.json` (engines, packageManager, scripts). Modify `Dockerfile` (multi-stage build with oven/bun base, non-root user llmux uid 1001). Modify `README.md` (npm→bun setup commands, Workers deploy command). Modify `workers/README.md` (npm→bun install/deploy commands). Delete `package-lock.json`, `workers/package-lock.json`. Create `bun.lock`, `workers/bun.lock`.

## Scripts (Root package.json)

`dev`: `"bun run --watch src/index.ts"` watches TypeScript. `build`: `"bun build --target=node src/index.ts --outdir=dist"` compiles. `start`: `"bun dist/index.js"` runs production. `lint`: `"bun oxlint src/"` lints. `lint:fix`: `"bun oxlint src/ --fix"` auto-fixes. `format`: `"bun oxfmt src/"` formats. `format:check`: `"bun oxfmt src/ --check"` validates. `typecheck`: `"bun tsc --noEmit"` validates TypeScript.

## Scripts (Workers package.json)

`dev`: `"wrangler dev"` local Workers server. `deploy`: `"wrangler deploy"` production deployment. `lint`: `"bun oxlint src/"` lints. `lint:fix`: `"bun oxlint src/ --fix"` auto-fixes. `format`: `"bun oxfmt src/"` formats. `format:check`: `"bun oxfmt src/ --check"` validates. `typecheck`: `"bun tsc --noEmit"` validates.

## Workflow & Conventions

Agentic workers MUST use `superpowers:subagent-driven-development` or `superpowers:executing-plans`. Track tasks via checkbox syntax `- [ ]`. Commit each task with pattern `chore: [action] for Bun migration` or `docs: [action]`. Run `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`, `docker build` before task completion.

## Verification Requirements

`bun run typecheck` must pass (no errors). `bun run lint` must pass (warnings acceptable). `bun install` generates `bun.lock`. Docker build completes. Source code unchanged (TypeScript, YAML, TOML, API surface). Wrangler retained for Cloudflare Workers deployment.
